added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the recorded byte size 1118176 is not the bundle's content size - it is du -sb of the scratch pull tree, which includes apparent directory-entry sizes; the sum of the 18 file sizes is 1117742 and du -sb on the /work bundle reads 1138222, so the figure is tree- and filesystem-dependent and a reader cannot reproduce it from the artifact.

item_verdicts.diff: read d593ae54 against base 952116f1 commit-by-commit; one file, 30 added lines, an evidence fragment carrying two fact tables and no executable change.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is the operational equality-and-access gate and I reproduced every clause against the artifact and the checkout at base 952116f1 - machine_map.json equals imas_ambix/data/machine_maps/jt-60sa.json except description_store_root=description; maps/{magnetics,pf_active,tf}.json and eddb_units.json are byte-equal; machine_description/OP1 and OP2 diff -r empty; gh api reports visibility private with version_count 1; token manifest fetch returns the artifact type and revision annotation while a credential-less fetch is refused; oras pull diff -r against the /work bundle is empty; and the clean-venv log ends ALL LOAD CHECKS PASS with EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to publish the JT-60SA maps as a flat single-machine bundle in private GHCR; the /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/maps tree is flat (bundle.json, machine_map.json, maps/, eddb_units.json, machine_description/) and the artifact ghcr.io/simon-mcintosh/imas-alambic-jt60sa:2026.10.07 exists, so the goal is met by the artifact plus its evidence fragment, the repo change being only the fragment.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the oras push/fetch/pull commands, the clean-venv load gate and their log paths, the digest sha256:6af476ebe1d560e290b90aeef83113f25a4b2982e24548542c556f7ebf7d3f90, the byte size and two follow-ons, and every result matches the log I opened.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares the fragment and a figures directory; the single commit d593ae54 changes only docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-facility-mint/jtfm-maps-to-ghcr.html, 30 added lines.

justifications.durability: the change is docs-only and adds no assertion, so neither the /work bundle nor the GHCR artifact has a committed test that fails if it regresses; the equality and load checks live only in one-shot evidence logs.
justifications.evidence: every done-when clause reproduces from the logs and from my own gh/oras checks, but the recorded byte size at docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-facility-mint/jtfm-maps-to-ghcr.html:18 is a du -sb tree size rather than the bundle's content size (see finding).
justifications.fit: the fragment follows the sibling idiom of docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-facility-mint/jtfm-flat-bundles.html (section class evidence-fragment, data-reckon, node-prefixed element ids) and its table form honours its own done-when's records-only constraint.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the flat bundle at /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/maps and the private artifact ghcr.io/simon-mcintosh/imas-alambic-jt60sa:2026.10.07 both match the goal, the landed repo change being the evidence fragment alone.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no definition that duplicates a repository capability; the published bundle reuses the flat-bundle layout owned by machine_map.py and the verification reuses oras and gh rather than any new registry client.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat over 952116f1..d593ae54 lists only docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-facility-mint/jtfm-maps-to-ghcr.html, inside the manifest's declared write paths.
